description: Publish 1 to 5 apps in ONE call, each at its own stable URL, all managed by ONE system token (ADR-0352). No account needed. Each app is a self-contained HTML file and goes through the same safety scan as dropyour_publish; an app that is refused does not block the others, and the answer names it with the reason. KEEP systemToken: it is shown once, and it manages every app of this system (pass it as managementToken to replace, configure or delete any of them), and nothing else. These apps are NOT linked to each other: you, the agent, use them together. Linking apps under a contract (dropyour_link) needs an account and graduated apps. Your tier: anonymous — max 5 MB per app, default expiration 30 days. With an account, what the app saves in localStorage is kept on our servers and "Who can edit" is "Only you" by default: visitors see the app but their changes are not saved, and the owner edits through a private edit link (cockpit, app page, Access, Open in edit mode). For an app where visitors write together (a shared list, a vote, a guestbook), pass editable: true ("Anyone"). The owner can change it later in the cockpit. The choice applies to every app of the system.

html.description: The complete self-contained HTML of this app (inline CSS/JS, max 5 MB)

key.description: A short unique key for this app inside the system, lowercase (e.g. "crm", "quotes").

name.description: A private name for this app. Default: its HTML <title>.

editable.description: Who can edit the data the app saves (its localStorage), once the app belongs to an account. Omit it for "Only you", the default: visitors read, the owner edits through a private edit link. true = "Anyone" who opens the app can change it (a collaborative app); false = "Only you". Without an account, the data stays in each visitor's browser and the choice applies when the app is attached to an account. Applies to every app of the system.

expiresInSeconds.description: Expiration for every app, in seconds (default: your tier's, 30 days).

name.description: A private name for the system (only you see it).
